programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: The Bedouin chief presents the children with the second veil they were looking for, passed down from generation to generation by the Chaldis tribe. They try to decipher a plan to the city of gold...

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Brandon throws Kayne an outrageous challenge: to attract a great white shark using nothing but his beatboxing skills. The idea is as wild as it sounds, pushing Kayne to combine rhythm, courage, and sheer audacity in a stunt that’s equal parts hilarious and terrifying. What could possibly go wrong in this jaw-dropping attempt at musical shark luring?

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.sub_title: I'm A Roadrunner And Smiling Faces Sometimes
programs.desc: Imaginative boy Ben transforms his city by bringing colourful street art to life, armed with a magic paintbrush and the classic sounds of Motown.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: While she's playing with two little porcupines, Pam stands on the tail of one of them. Claiming it was an accident, she refuses to apologise. Later, she realizes that apologising is nice thing to do.

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: Not far from Barkar, Bob asks Spartakus about his past. He then tells how, when he was a child, he saw his family massacred by the Gladiators, then how he became a Gladiator.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Connie asks 'Why do the seasons change?' and Grandpa spins a tall tale about four rhubarb-loving monsters who live inside the planet and the little girl who teaches them a lesson.
